headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS

bullets_en: The court issued notice against Aaditya Thackeray.
Police arrested one accused in connection with a case.
Gang involved in cattle theft, mobile shop burglaries held in Telangana.
Mamata’s Rejinagar bypoll candidate announces withdrawal from contest, retracts later.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah falls ill in Hubballi, skips inauguration of college.
bullets_ur: The court ne Aaditya Thackeray ke khilaf notice jaari kiya.
Police ne ek case ke silsile mein ek mulzim ko giraftaar kar liya.
Gang involved cattle theft mein, mobile shop burglaries ne Telangana ka inqiad kiya.
Mamata’s Rejinagar bypoll candidate ne withdrawal contest se, retracts later ka elan kiya.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah ill Hubballi mein gira.
